# System 4 -- Analysis Report (auto-generated by tools/run_analysis)

Every number in this file was produced by running the code in this repository on
**synthetic** datasets (duration 60 s, 500 Hz IMU). Nothing is typed in by hand.
Model A = float32 study pipeline, Model B = fixed-point study pipeline
(PENDING INTEGRATION with the real ES-EKF modules of members 1-3).

Float32 reference accuracy (UDU kernels vs an independent dense double-precision covariance EKF, worst relative error of diag(P) at the end of the run):

| scenario | worst relative P_ii error of Model A |
|---|---|
| static | 7.826e-05 |
| constvel | 7.135e-05 |
| dynamic | 5.300e-05 |
| highrange | 7.580e-05 |

Fixed-vs-float covariance differences at or below this level cannot be attributed to the fixed-point model (the reference itself is float32).
